title: MonsterMQ Edge
description: Schema for the monster-mq-edge config.yaml. Mirrors internal/config/config.go.

NodeId.description: Identifier for this broker instance, recorded with sessions and metrics; devices run on the node whose NodeId they name. Empty (default) = the hostname, or 'edge' when the hostname is unknown (rejected with PeerLink enabled). Must differ per host when PeerLink is used; PeerLink compares it in lower case and needs 1-64 characters out of [a-z0-9._-].

SSL.title: SSL / TLS Encryption
SSL.description: SSL/TLS certificate configuration for encrypted MQTT connections (TCPS and WSS). These settings are used by the MQTTS (TCPS) listener, and also serve as the fallback for the WSS listener when the optional 'WSS' override below is not set.

KeyStorePath.title: KeyStore File Path
KeyStorePath.description: Path to the keystore file containing the server certificate and private key. When KeyStoreType is PEM, this is the certificate (or fullchain) PEM file path instead.

KeyStorePassword.title: KeyStore Password
KeyStorePassword.description: Password for accessing the keystore file. Ignored when KeyStoreType is PEM.

KeyStoreType.title: KeyStore Format
KeyStoreType.description: Keystore format: JKS (Java KeyStore), PKCS12 / PFX / P12 (industry standard), or PEM (separate certificate + private key files).

KeyPath.title: Private Key File Path (PEM only)
KeyPath.description: Path to the private key PEM file. Only used when KeyStoreType is PEM.

ClientAuth.title: Client Certificate Verification
ClientAuth.description: Enables mutual TLS (mTLS) on the MQTTS (TCPS) listener by requesting/requiring a client certificate, verified against TrustStorePath. NONE is the default and matches prior behavior (no client certificate requested). Not applied to the WSS listener.

TrustStorePath.title: TrustStore / CA File Path
TrustStorePath.description: Path to a truststore (JKS/PKCS12) or a CA certificate PEM file (when TrustStoreType is PEM) used to verify client certificates when ClientAuth is REQUEST or REQUIRED.

TrustStorePassword.title: TrustStore Password
TrustStorePassword.description: Password for accessing the truststore file. Ignored when TrustStoreType is PEM.

TrustStoreType.title: TrustStore Format
TrustStoreType.description: Truststore format: JKS, PKCS12 / PFX / P12, or PEM (a single CA certificate file).

UseIdentityAsUsername.title: Use Certificate Common Name as Username
UseIdentityAsUsername.description: When ClientAuth is REQUEST or REQUIRED and the client presents a valid certificate, its Common Name (CN) is used as the authenticated identity and the password check is skipped. The matching user account still governs permissions and ACL rules, and a disabled account is rejected. Only applies to the MQTTS (TCPS) listener; has no effect if the client presents no certificate or if UserManagement is disabled.

AutoCreateUser.title: Auto-Create User For Certificate Common Name
AutoCreateUser.description: Only used together with UseIdentityAsUsername. When false (default), a certificate whose Common Name has no user account is rejected, so accounts must be created up front. When true, the account is created automatically on first connect with default, non-admin permissions.

WSS.title: WSS Listener Certificate Override
WSS.description: Optional independent certificate for the Secure WebSocket (WSS) listener. Falls back to the KeyStore settings above when not set.

KeyStorePath.title: KeyStore File Path
KeyStorePath.description: Path to the keystore file for the WSS listener.

KeyStorePassword.title: KeyStore Password
KeyStorePassword.description: Password for accessing the WSS keystore file.

KeyPath.title: Private Key File Path (PEM only)
KeyPath.description: Path to the private key PEM file for WSS.

MaxMessageSize.description: Maximum MQTT packet size in bytes.

DefaultStoreType.description: Backend used by every store unless overridden below. WINCCOA (WinCC OA manager only): configs, sessions, retained messages and users in WinCC OA datapoints, queue and metrics in memory, no database file.

UserStoreType.description: Store of MQTT users and ACL rules; falls back to DefaultStoreType. Only WINCCOA (MMQUsers datapoints, WinCC OA manager only) may differ from DefaultStoreType.

SessionStoreType.description: Override for the session/subscription store; falls back to DefaultStoreType. MEMORY uses an in-memory SQLite database. WINCCOA keeps them in MMQSessions datapoints (WinCC OA manager only).

RetainedStoreType.description: Override for the retained-message store; falls back to DefaultStoreType. MEMORY = built-in in-memory map only, no DB persistence and no startup load. WINCCOA = one MMQRetained datapoint per retained topic (WinCC OA manager only).

ConfigStoreType.description: Override for the device-config and archive-config store; falls back to DefaultStoreType. WINCCOA keeps them in MMQConfigs datapoints (WinCC OA manager only).

QueueStoreType.description: Override for the queued-message store; falls back to DefaultStoreType. MEMORY uses an in-memory SQLite database and does not survive restart.

Path.description: Filesystem path to the SQLite database file.

Url.description: CrateDB PostgreSQL-wire URL (postgres://host:5432/doc or the Java form jdbc:postgresql://host:5432/doc). Default connection of archive groups with archiveType CRATEDB.

Enabled.description: When false, all clients are accepted (anonymous).

AnonymousEnabled.description: When true, missing credentials are allowed even with UserManagement.Enabled=true.

AclCheckOnSubscription.description: When false, wildcard subscriptions (e.g. #) are allowed and ACL is enforced at message delivery time instead. Default true.

AllowAnonymousLocalhost.description: When true, requests and connections originating from 127.0.0.1 (localhost) are allowed without authentication for MQTT, GraphQL, and HMI.

StoreType.description: Where metrics history is stored. Omit to use DefaultStoreType. MEMORY avoids flash writes; NONE disables history storage while keeping live metrics.

RetentionHours.description: Hours of metrics to retain. 0 disables retention pruning.

MaxHistoryRows.description: Maximum in-memory metric rows retained when StoreType=MEMORY. 0 uses the built-in default.

MqttSyslogEnabled.description: Forward log records to a $SYS/log topic.

RingBufferSize.description: In-memory log ring buffer size, surfaced via GraphQL logTail.

Port.description: HTTP port (plain). When defined (> 0), HTTP is enabled.

TLSPort.description: HTTPS port (TLS). When defined (> 0), HTTPS is enabled (generates self-signed cert if missing).

RequireHTTPSFromOutside.description: Require HTTPS for external connections, allowing plain HTTP only from localhost

KeyStorePath.description: Path to TLS certificate (defaults to SSL.KeyStorePath or data/server.crt)

KeyPath.description: Path to TLS private key (defaults to SSL.KeyPath or data/server.key)

Dashboard.title: Web Dashboard Hosting
Dashboard.description: Embedded Siemens iX Web Dashboard configuration (served from GraphQL HTTP port)

Enabled.title: Enable Dashboard
Enabled.description: Enable serving the web dashboard UI

Path.title: Custom Dashboard Path
Path.description: Filesystem path to override dashboard files for live UI development. Leave empty to serve from embedded bundle.

Enabled.description: Serve /api/v1 on the GraphQL HTTP listener.

SyncEnabled.description: Enable MQTT-based file synchronization for HMI assets.

SyncBaseTopic.description: Base topic prefix for HMI synchronization channels.

Enabled.description: Enable the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server mounted at /mcp.

Features.description: Subsystem feature toggles. Mirrors the Features map in the main monster-mq broker.

MqttClient.description: Enable the outbound MQTT bridge client manager.

WinCCUa.description: Enable the WinCC Unified bridge (GraphQL or Open Pipe transports).

WinCCOa.description: Enable the WinCC Open Architecture bridge (GraphQL/WebSocket transport).

DeviceImportExport.description: Enable generic device configuration export/import GraphQL operations.

Mcp.description: Enable the MCP server feature toggle.

Hmi.description: Enable HTML/JS HMI hosting feature toggle.

Redfish.description: Enable DMTF Redfish REST API feature toggle.

RtspCamera.description: Enable RTSP camera stream snapshot capture and round-robin publishing.

WorkerPoolSize.description: Number of concurrent worker threads for script execution.

QueueBufferSize.description: Buffer capacity for pending script execution tasks.

DefaultTimeoutMs.description: Default timeout in milliseconds per script execution.

AllowRootWildcardSubscription.description: Allow subscriptions to the root wildcard '#'. When false, '#' is rejected (SUBACK 0x8F), and so are native WinCC OA wildcard filters that cover every datapoint (winccoa/<scope>/tags/#, tags/+/..., types/#).

WinCCOaNative.description: Bootstrap settings used only when the broker runs embedded in a WinCC OA API manager. Ignored by the standalone binary.

Enabled.description: Enable the native WinCC OA embedding features.

Namespace.description: Expose <TopicRoot>/<SystemsName>/<system>/<TagsName>|<TypesName> topics, validated subscriptions and typed writes.

TopicRoot.description: First topic level(s) of the native namespace, e.g. winccoa or plant/oa. The status topic is <TopicRoot>/<SystemsName>/<system>.

TypesName.description: Topic level for access through the datapoint type: <TopicRoot>/<SystemsName>/<system>/<TypesName>/<dpt>/<dp>/...

SystemsName.description: Topic level before every system name: <TopicRoot>/<SystemsName>/<system>/...

TopicDpNames.description: Datapoint names of the topics branch: HASH = MMQTopic_k<hash of the topic>, NAME = MMQTopic_<topic> with characters not allowed in datapoint names (and %) as %XX (hex); names over 128 characters fall back to the hash. All brokers of a distributed system must use the same naming.

TopicsName.description: Topic level for MQTT topics kept in MMQTopic datapoints and replicated through WinCC OA: <TopicRoot>/<SystemsName>/<system>/<TopicsName>/<topic>.

LocalShortcut.description: Also offer the local system without the system part: <TopicRoot>/<TagsName>/..., <TopicRoot>/<TypesName>/..., status on <TopicRoot>.

EchoPolicy.description: How values written through MQTT are echoed to native subscribers.

Port.description: Port for standalone Redfish REST server. Set to 0 to mount on main GraphQL port.

MountPath.description: HTTP URL prefix for Redfish REST API.

AnonymousEnabled.description: Allow anonymous read access to Redfish endpoints.

Enabled.description: Enable host monitoring to periodically publish CPU, memory, and disk stats to MQTT.

BaseTopic.description: The topic format to publish metrics to. Replaces {NodeId} or {node_id}.

IntervalSeconds.description: The frequency in seconds to collect and publish stats.

QoS.description: The MQTT QoS level to publish messages with (0, 1, or 2).

QueuedMessagesEnabled.description: true: store messages for offline persistent (clean=false) sessions in the QueueStore so they survive broker restart. false: rely on the in-memory inflight buffer (lost on restart).

MaxQueueMessages.description: Max offline messages queued per client. 0 means unlimited.

QueueBatchSize.description: The maximum number of queued messages to buffer before flushing to the database.

QueueFlushIntervalMs.description: The interval in milliseconds to wait before flushing buffered queued messages to the database.

Runtime.description: Go runtime settings of the whole broker process.

MemoryLimitMB.description: Soft memory limit in MiB (debug.SetMemoryLimit). 0 keeps the Go default. With PeerLink, at least 2.2 x PeerLink.Log.MaxBytes + 150 MiB is recommended (startup WARN otherwise).

PeerLink.title: PeerLink
PeerLink.description: Pull-based in-memory forwarding of publishes between MonsterMQ Edge brokers, one hop, configured on both sides: the consumer lists the source with an Address, the source lists the consumer with Serve: true. Every topic is captured except $-topics, Capture.Exclude and, while WinCC OA native mode is active, the WinCC OA namespace (<TopicRoot>). Unknown keys in this section fail startup, also while it is disabled. Authentication fails closed: every peer must be authenticated by mTLS or a shared secret over TLS, unless AllowUnauthenticatedPeers is set.

AllowUnauthenticatedPeers.description: Admit peers without certificate or secret. Accepted only with a non-empty Listener.AllowedNetworks and UserManagement disabled; logs a WARN on every start.

Listener.description: Peer port, bound when any peer has Serve: true.

AllowedNetworks.description: CIDR allow-list checked before TLS, e.g. ["10.10.0.0/24"]. Empty = every address.

AllowPlaintext.description: A TLS listener also accepts plaintext sessions (TLS migration only); needs AllowUnauthenticatedPeers.

Tls.description: This node's peer identity and trust. Paths may contain {NodeId}. Never uses the system roots.

Enabled.description: Listener TLS and the default for dialers. Needs CertPath and KeyPath, or AutoGenerate.

CertPath.description: PEM certificate (ServerAuth and ClientAuth). With AutoGenerate the default is certs/peer-{NodeId}.pem.

KeyPath.description: PEM private key. With AutoGenerate the default is certs/peer-{NodeId}.key.

TrustStorePath.description: PEM CA file or legacy PKCS12 truststore that verifies peer certificates. Empty = no chain verification (pins or secrets only). Prefer a CA dedicated to peers.

ClientAuth.description: Client certificates on the listener. REQUEST or REQUIRED need TrustStorePath, or pins on every Serve peer.

IdentityFallback.description: Peer identity is the URI SAN urn:monstermq:node:<NodeId>. For PKIs without URI SANs, a certificate without such a SAN may instead match by a DNS SAN (DNS) or the Common Name (CN) equal to the NodeId.

AutoGenerate.description: Create a self-signed ECDSA certificate for this NodeId when the files are missing; its SPKI SHA-256 is logged.

SharedSecrets.description: Group secrets (base64, at least 16 bytes), first = current, others still accepted. Require Tls.Enabled; bound to the TLS session.

Log.description: In-memory log of the publishes this node offers to its peers.

MaxBytes.description: At least 1 MiB and 4 x MaxRecordBytes. The oldest records are dropped (and counted) when full.

MaxRecordBytes.description: 0 = MaxMessageSize + 64 KiB (1 MiB + 64 KiB when MaxMessageSize is 0). Larger publishes are not captured.

DrainOnShutdownMs.description: On shutdown, wait for connected peers to pull what was captured; 0 = off. 5000 is recommended on WinCC OA hosts.

NeverConnectedWarnSec.description: WARN when a Serve peer has not connected after this many seconds; it pins the log meanwhile.

Wills.description: Forward wills, never those of this broker's own shutdown.

Include.description: Empty = ["#"]. $-topics are never captured, nor the WinCC OA namespace while native mode is active.

Exclude.description: Wins over Include. null = [<HMI.SyncBaseTopic>/#]; [] also forwards the HMI sync channel.

EchoSuppressMs.description: Do not capture a publish that repeats a replica (same topic, payload and retain flag) applied within this window; 0 = off.

Mode.description: FILL: on first contact and after a source restart, retained messages are copied where the receiver has none.

Fetch.description: How this node pulls from its sources.

MaxWaitMs.description: Long-poll wait, at least 10; must be below KeepAliveSeconds*1000.

CrcOnTls.description: Batch CRC32C also on TLS links (always on plaintext links).

ReconnectMaxMs.description: Cap of the exponential reconnect backoff.

Receive.description: How replicas from peers are applied on this node.

Bus.description: Deliver replicas to the internal bus (scripts, REST SSE, GraphQL subscriptions, Redfish).

BridgeOutbound.description: MQTT bridges forward replicas to their remote broker (loop risk).

Archive.description: Archive replicas; set false when both nodes archive into one shared database.

Queue.description: Queue replicas for offline persistent sessions.

SharedSubscriptions.description: SKIP: shared subscription groups get a message only on the node it was published on.

MarkReplicas.description: Add the user property mmq-peer-src=<NodeId> to replicas.

CatchUpRateFactor.description: While behind, apply at most this factor x the source's publish rate; 0 = no pacing, otherwise at least 1.5.

MaxApplyRate.description: Absolute cap in messages per second; 0 = off.

MaxRecordAgeMs.description: Drop live replicas older than this (retained ones are applied silently); 0 = off.

MaxFrameBytes.description: Largest frame accepted from a source; at least Fetch.MaxBytes + 64 KiB.

InjectWorkers.description: Reserved: one injector per source applies records in order; values above 1 log a WARN.

Peers.description: Other nodes. The entry whose NodeId equals this node's (case-insensitive; with NodeId from the hostname also its first label) is ignored, so one file can serve every host.

Address.description: host:port of the peer's PeerLink listener; present = this node pulls from it.

Serve.description: The peer may pull from this node.

SharedSecrets.description: Per-peer secrets (base64, at least 16 bytes); replace the group secrets for this peer. Recommended with more than two nodes.

Enabled.description: Dialer TLS towards this peer; null = PeerLink.Tls.Enabled.

PinnedSha256.description: SHA-256 of the peer's SubjectPublicKeyInfo or certificate (hex); a match replaces chain verification.

CertificateIdentity.description: Accepted certificate identity instead of urn:monstermq:node:<NodeId> (exact URI SAN or DNS SAN).

RequireClientCert.description: Require a client certificate from this peer (needs Tls.ClientAuth REQUEST or REQUIRED).

InsecureSkipVerify.description: Do not verify the peer's certificate; the pull direction then counts as unauthenticated unless a shared secret is used.

RedundancyPartner.description: The peer is the other host of this node's redundant WinCC OA system. With RetainedStoreType WINCCOA on both sides and the same system name, retained replicas only update the in-memory view (oaRetained); WinCC OA replicates MMQRetained itself.

Address.description: Bind address. Defaults to 0.0.0.0 (IPv4). Use '::' for IPv6 dual-stack.

KeyStorePath.description: PKCS#12/JKS keystore path or PEM certificate path (TLS listeners only).

KeyStorePassword.description: Password for the keystore (TLS listeners only).

ClientAuth.description: Client certificate verification mode (TCPS listener only).

TrustStorePath.description: Path to truststore or CA certificate file (TCPS listener only).

TrustStorePassword.description: Password for the truststore (TCPS listener only).

UseIdentityAsUsername.description: Use verified client certificate Common Name as authenticated username (TCPS listener only).

AutoCreateUser.description: Auto-create user account on first connect when UseIdentityAsUsername is enabled (TCPS listener only).
